verdict.rationale: Control over retention is only implied, not documented. The evidence says the SDK keeps prompts, audio and images on the device, works offline without an account, and sends requests to Wally Cloud only when the user explicitly chooses hosted execution. A community reply also states that no data is collected. Missing for 10: any documented retention policy for Wally Cloud requests, user-facing deletion controls (e.g. deleting account data, logs or history), configurable retention windows, and independent verification of the no-collection claim.
